profile_text.body:
Appian Corp describes itself as a provider of AI-powered process orchestration for enterprises. Its website says the company orchestrates AI agents, systems, and people on a unified platform without replacing existing systems, and that it has been automating processes for more than 25 years. The company states it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it promotes an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The site lists AI automation use cases including accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing, reconciliation, sourcing, contracts, supplier data, audit workflows, attestations, case resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order intake, fulfillment, exceptions, and contract review. It says customers can build AI-powered apps with no code, embed AI agents to extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts, and that onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%.

Appian Corp is a for-profit public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, trading under ticker APPN, with SEC CIK 0001441683. Its aliases include APPIAN CORP and APPIAN CORP-A. The company has 152 Virginia law exposure entries. No lawsuits are recorded for the company.
